## Purpose
Aggregator for `app.models`: it imports every SQLAlchemy model and Pydantic schema module in the package so that (a) `Base.metadata` sees every mapped model for Alembic autogenerate/migration checks, and (b) callers can import model/schema symbols from `app.models` directly instead of from each submodule.

## Shape
- Imports `Base`, `SessionLocal`, `engine`, `get_db` from `app.models.database`.
- Imports the core mapped models: `User`, `ChatSession`/`Message`, `WorkflowRun`, `RevokedToken` (+ `cleanup_expired_revocations`).
- A long run of `# noqa: F401` imports (`WorkflowClarification`, `WorkflowMemory`, `WorkflowDefinition`, `ArtifactRef`, `Workspace`, `RunEvent`, `DeepLinkNonce`, `RunCapabilities`, `ValidationResult`, `GateEvent`, `HookRun`, `Repository`, `McpCredential`, `ExecRun`, `SubagentRun`, `WaveRun`) — each comment-tagged with the phase/migration that introduced it.
- Imports handoff-related models/constants from `app.models.handoff` and API-facing Pydantic schemas from `app.models.schemas`.
- A single `__all__` list re-exporting all of the above as the package's public surface.

## Why this shape
Comments in the file are explicit: models must be imported here (not just defined in their own module) "so that Base.metadata sees them for Alembic autogenerate/check" — otherwise a model that's never imported anywhere is invisible to Alembic's schema diffing and the in-memory-SQLite test harness. The ordering comment about `WorkflowClarification` also notes it must be imported before the `WorkflowRun` mapper is finalized so `relationship()` references resolve correctly.
